why_defective: Chapter 4 must present strictly ONE final sample (N = 483). Detailing sample reduction (e.g., initial sample vs harnessed sample) in Chapter 4 creates confusion and violates the methodological reporting standard where such procedures belong exclusively in Chapter 3.
observed_symptoms: Presence of phrases like 'نمونه اولیه' (initial sample) in Chapter 4 text or tables.
Presence of phrases like 'نمونه مهارشده' (harnessed sample) or 'نمونه نهایی' (final sample) in Chapter 4.
Discussing sample harnessing or reduction processes in Chapter 4.
corrective_remedy: Refer to the sample strictly and simply as 'نمونه پژوهش (N = ۴۸۳)' or 'نمونه پژوهش'. Remove all mentions of initial or harnessed sample counts from Chapter 4.
